## The idea

<!-- What should the encyclopedia have, and why does it help a reader? -->

## Where it belongs

<!-- The subject, the lesson, the laboratory, the reference, the practice
     section. If you do not know, say so; it is not a reason to hold the
     idea back. -->

## What it would teach

<!-- The idea, the derivation, the situation in which it fails. The
     encyclopedia holds every technique to the third question, so a proposal
     that answers the first two is already half of the work. -->

## What is already in the encyclopedia

<!-- The closest lesson, the closest technique, and what it does not cover.
     A proposal that fills a gap is easier to accept and easier to place. -->

## The implementations

<!-- If a technique is proposed, does it need a listing? In which languages?
     The rule of the repository is that a listing is a real source file that
     is compiled and run, and that the six languages must agree. -->
